requirements_summary: Northstar is in procurement with a security addendum that explicitly calls out SIEM integration for audit events as a required control. They want Redwood audit events exported to Splunk (preferred) with a secondary option for S3 delivery for long-term retention/forensics. Key asks: configurable filtering by audit category/action/resource; stable event_id for dedup; at-least-once delivery semantics with retries/backoff + DLQ/replay story; operational visibility (lag, last success, errors) and a supportable incident playbook. Must-have security posture: least-privilege RBAC for managing export configs, encrypted delivery and storage (KMS acceptable), secret handling (no plaintext tokens in logs), and explicit language separating Redwood retention vs customer SIEM retention. They will accept “beta” status if limitations are clearly documented and there’s a credible GA path; they do not want Private/on-prem commitments in the addendum for this phase.
